text:
**Wedding Toast**

Good evening, everyone! For those who don't know me, I'm [Your Name], [Name]'s best friend, which means I've been blamed for most of the questionable decisions in this love story, starting with the camping trip.

Yes, the camping trip. It rained for two days straight. The tent, which I was promised was "waterproof," turned out to be more of a suggestion. Someone forgot the matches, someone else forgot the food, and we ate trail mix for dinner. Twice. At one point, we held a serious group meeting to decide whether the noise outside was a bear. It was a raccoon with a lot of confidence.

But in the middle of that soggy chaos, there were [Partner's Name] and [Name], huddled under a leaking tarp, sharing the last dry granola bar and talking as if they were at a candlelit dinner. I remember thinking, "Either they're falling in love, or hypothermia is setting in."

Turns out, it was love.

Here's what that weekend taught me. Anyone can be charming when everything goes right. But these two found each other when *nothing* did, and they chose each other anyway. They don't just survive bad weather. They turn it into a great story.

[Name], [Partner's Name], you've shown all of us that the right person doesn't make life perfect. They make the mess feel like an adventure.

So may your marriage hold far more sunshine than that trip did, and when the rain does come, may you always find shelter in each other.

Everyone, please raise your glasses: to [Name] and [Partner's Name]!
